record.name: Jamaica
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A reconstituted National AI Task Force is drafting a national AI policy, due by November 2026, and a legislative framework within 12 months of February 2026.

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The Prime Minister's Office and government information service describe the National AI Task Force's policy and legislative deliverables, including a draft policy due in November 2026.

related_bodies.name: National AI Task Force (Office of the Prime Minister)
related_bodies.role: It is drafting the national AI policy and a legislative framework; it is advisory, with no model evaluation mandate.

record.notes: Both sources are government (primary). The task force of 23 members, chaired by Christopher Reckord, was convened on 19 February 2026. No regulator or safety institute is named; the Jamaica ICT Authority and the Management Institute for National Development were mentioned only in training and partner roles. A UNESCO readiness assessment finding of no dedicated AI regulator was seen in a search summary but not opened.

next_check.reason: Check whether the draft AI policy was published in November and whether it proposes a regulator or testing body.
